info.name: GhorBD API
info.description:
REST API behind ghorbd.com: property listings for rent and sale across Bangladesh (apartment, room, house, hotel, shop, office, land), with search, favourites, notifications, Q&A, a blog and admin moderation.

**Full integration guide:** `docs/api/README.md` in the backend repo.

## Quick start
1. Pick an environment (Local / Staging / Production). `baseUrl` already ends in `/api`.
2. Run **Auth → Log in**. The test script saves `accessToken`, `refreshToken` and `userId` into the environment.
3. Every other request uses `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`, inherited from the collection.
4. When a call returns `401 TOKEN_EXPIRED`, run **Auth → Refresh the session**. Access tokens last 15 minutes and refresh tokens last 30 days.

## Conventions
- Single item: `{ "data": { … } }`
- List: `{ "data": [ … ], "meta": { "page", "perPage", "total", "totalPages" } }`
- Error: `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details?" } }`. Branch on `code`, not on `message`.
- ids are 24-character hex strings. Dates are ISO-8601 UTC. Money is whole taka (BDT) unless the field name ends in `Minor`.
- Pagination: `?page=1&perPage=12`. `perPage` can be at most 60.
- A resource you are not allowed to see returns **404**, not 403.

request.description:
Creates a tenant or owner account. **Email verification is mandatory by default**: the response then contains NO tokens and `verification.emailOtpRequired: true`; a 6-digit code + link are emailed. Finish signup with POST /auth/verify-email-otp. If the server has email verification disabled, tokens are returned immediately. Phone OTP is currently OFF (`verification.required: false`). Outside production `devEmailOtp` / `devEmailToken` / `devOtp` are included so QA can test without a mailbox.

Rate limit: 20 **failed** attempts / 15 min per IP.

**Auth:** none
